subject: english
stem: Here is today's first notice. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: light rain is expected after eight thirty near the library
heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library
heavy rain is expected before eleven twenty near the library
heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the music room

optionRationales.reason: light rain is expected after eight thirty near the library：此項把「heavy」改成「light」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。
heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。

heavy rain is expected before eleven twenty near the library：此項把「after eight thirty」改成「before eleven twenty」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。

heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the music room：此項把「library」改成「music room」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：逐句比對鎖定逐字稿，答案為「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」。
獨立覆核 B：重新依時間順序核對說話者、細節與行動，只有「heavy rain is expected after eight thirty near the library」成立。
